notes.title: Zelle update ver1.3
notes.content:
The app version of Zelle has been released this time, and a big update is coming!
[b]But if you restart the game using past save data, a bug may occur depending on the restarted part. [/b]
There is no problem if you start from NewGame, this update contains many program changes, so it is not possible to cover all existing save data. I apologize for any inconvenience, but please be careful when updating.

The contents of the update are as follows.
-Added 9 languages ​​in addition to Japanese and English.
-Added side screen for playing with a larger screen size.
-Added flashback scene with Reaper Zogzo.
-Improved overall performance.
-Other minor changes.

Thank you for your cooperation.
We are also considering a sale as well, so please take this opportunity to play.

An app version has also been released, so if you want to relax and play the game in bed, please check this out too!
[url=zelle.odencat.com]zelle.odencat.com[/url]

Fuming

notes.title: ADV game "Zelle" is coming soon.
notes.content:
Hi, this is Fuming who developed this game.
First, I'm sorry for my poor English, I mainly speak Japanese.
(But this game is translated by Elizabeth pro translator, don't worry.)

Zelle is a occult adventure game. You can explore the inside and outside of the castle using adventure game mechanics and battle demons with strategic mouse clicks. Your goal in this game is to bring the protagonist home.

The debugging session is already finished, so I can publish the game on that day 4. Oct without problem.
I want to give heartfelt thanks who people cooperated in testing my game.
You can see their name on ending of game.
(And also, you can hear wonderfully song sung by Yumeko and music composed by Xion.)

I explained this game is "Occult adventure" because it's not a horror game in the traditional sense. You can see very weird world in this game, but I mainly focused on the story about the protagonist "Emerada". This is one night in the story of a little boy’s life.

And I plan to release sale only for the first week when the game is published, so please don't miss it. I hope you like this game :)
